description: The user's heistclips autopilot queue: clips that are ready to cut from the Twitch and Kick streamers on their watchlist (live streams and new VODs are re-read every 10 minutes), each with a hook line, a caption, why chat exploded, and the best-paying clipping campaign it fits with that campaign's $ per clip and rules still to check. Answers 'what should I clip today', 'any new clips', 'what's in my queue'. Takes the account code (hc_…) from watch_streamer or cut_clip, or the private queue link the user copied from heistclips.com/queue. Each clip carries cut_with values for cut_clip.

account.description: The account code (hc_…) from watch_streamer or cut_clip

queue_link.description: Or: the private link from the user's queue page (heistclips.com/queue?k=…), exactly as they pasted it

name: my_clip_queue
title: My clip queue: ready clips from the streamers I watch, matched to the campaign that pays
